request.description: Characterize the compiled two-joint MuJoCo dynamics and execute the reviewed independent verification of the resulting artifact.
request.rationale: The first decision is whether bounded 50 Hz motor control has adequate authority across reset singularity escape and representative official inner/outer IK postures. This operation measures the compiled quantities omitted from the XML and deterministic saturated/zero-command responses before attributing any future failure to policy learning. If responses are nonzero, repeatable, and settle with substantial margin, the next direction should test learned coverage and hold regulation; if they are weak or poorly damped in a regime, the next direction should investigate control-aware learning and that physical bottleneck. The verification is included to detect static, truncated, mistimed, or out-of-bounds measurement implementations rather than to certify task success.
